stage: A — protocol lock (written before the smoke test, per external_data_collection_plan_2026.md's execution ladder)

source_paper.title: Gradients with Respect to Semantics Preserving Embeddings Tell the Uncertainty of Large Language Models
source_paper.authors: Mingda Li, Rundong Lv, Xinyu Li, Weinan Zhang, Ting Liu

official_code.note: main branch HEAD at fetch time; re-fetch at this hash for byte-identical files.

files.sciq_test.jsonl: data/datasets/sciq/test.jsonl in the official repo, 1000 rows
files.truthfulqa_test.jsonl: data/datasets/truthfulqa/test.jsonl in the official repo, 817 rows
files.official_bem_reference.py: uncertainty/generation_evaluation/metrics/bem.py, kept verbatim as the ground-truth reference for spectral_utils/bem_scorer.py

model.note: Official repo's own llm.py config has a literal leading-slash bug ('/Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507'); the intended HF id has no leading slash, confirmed against the sibling qwen3-30b-instruct entry which has no such typo.
model.revision_pin: NONE UPSTREAM — the SemGrad repo and paper pin no model commit/revision and no transformers version. Record whatever revision resolves at download time in cluster/manifests/*_run.json once the pilot actually runs (see write_manifest() in cluster/run_inference.py, which already does this automatically per-job).

prompt.template:
Please directly answer the following question with one or few words:
{query}
prompt.rendering: tokenizer.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True), single user turn — matches this repo's existing fmt_prompt() default exactly, no raw_prompt override needed.

decoding.note: spectral_utils/model_utils.py's generate_full does `sampling = temp > 1e-4`, so temps=[0.0] already gives exact greedy decoding — no code change was needed for this.

telemetry_capture.reason: needed for the pre-registered G-NLL competitor (full-vocab logsumexp from raw pre-warp logits)

inline_at_generation.status: INTERIM ONLY — drives presets.py's acc_band/min_minority sanity gate, not the authoritative label

authoritative_offline.checkpoint: kagglehub: google/bert/tensorFlow2/answer-equivalence-bem (replaces the dead tfhub.dev/google/answer_equivalence/bem/1 URL the paper's own code uses)
authoritative_offline.threshold_source: uncertainty/generation_evaluation/utils.py compute_score(threshold=0.8) default — NEVER stated in the paper text
authoritative_offline.truncation: candidate truncated from the end if question+reference+candidate > 508 tokens; question and reference never truncated
authoritative_offline.empty_candidate_handling: empty string candidate replaced with literal "None" before scoring
authoritative_offline.implementation: spectral_utils/bem_scorer.py (reimplements the official tokenization/segment-packing in pure Python + transformers.BertTokenizer over the same vendored vocab.txt, avoiding tensorflow_text/tensorflow_hub)
authoritative_offline.runs_on: LOCAL machine, NOT the AIRCC B200/NGC cluster — BEM only scores already-generated text triples and never touches the LLM

comparison_level.definition: same dataset only (external_data_collection_plan_2026.md's Comparison Levels) — model/prompt/decoding are ours, matched to the official protocol, but the pre-registered LN-PE/G-NLL competitor pair is computed on THIS run's single greedy generation, not the paper's own 10-sample @ T=1.0 baseline protocol.
comparison_level.explicit_non_claim: This pilot does NOT reproduce or claim to reproduce SemGrad's own cited LN-PE/SemGrad/HybridGrad AUROC numbers.

method_roster_for_fitting.status: OUT OF SCOPE for this manifest — confirmed with Omri 2026-08-07. This job collects raw generation + telemetry only; which of our own fusion methods (U-PCR, L-SML, etc.) get fit on this data is a separate later decision, not part of the pilot's protocol lock.

pilot_health_gate.rule: no AUROC or method-selection claim from this pilot — schema/accuracy/telemetry validation only
pilot_health_gate.minimum_class_balance: at least 30 correct and 30 incorrect per cell (post-BEM-regrade) before any AUROC is treated as meaningful
next_steps_require_separate_approval: scaling to full N (1000 SciQ / 817 TruthfulQA)
adding TriviaQA or the other two models (Mistral-Nemo-12B, Llama-3.1-8B)
fitting any fusion method on this cell
